entry.title: Awesome V Updates on Jul 20 - Jul 26, 2026
entry.content:
Command-line

  • vin32 (⭐0) - A basic, heuristic-based CLI tool to generate V language bindings from simple Windows C header files.
  • vtrace (⭐1) - An automated execution tracer and step-by-step source code instrumenter for the V programming language.

Eventing

  • rxv (⭐16) - Reactive Extensions for the V language. Compose async event streams with creation, filtering, transformation, aggregation, timing, and combination operators.

Graphics

  • vsl.vcl (⭐401) - VCL is a high level way of writing programs with OpenCL using V. These are highly opinionated OpenCL bindings for V. It tries to make GPU computing easy, with some sugar abstraction, V's concurrency and channels.
  • vsl.plot (⭐401) - Plotting module for VSL with 85+ examples. Create line charts, scatter plots, 3D surfaces, bar charts, box plots, histograms, heatmaps, and more.

Networking

  • netr (⭐3) - A modular, zero-dependency raw socket and network packet crafting library written in V.

Operating system

  • rgc (⭐0) - A lightweight, concurrent resource garbage collector for V.
  • vcomp (⭐0) - A lightweight Linux Seccomp (Secure Computing Mode) BPF filter wrapper for vlang.

Scientific computing

  • vsl.fft (⭐401) - Fast Fourier Transform module for VSL. Includes real and complex FFT with multiple backend options.
  • vsl.ml (⭐401) - Machine Learning module for VSL with K-means, KNN, linear/logistic regression, SVM, decision trees, random forest, and more.
  • vsl.quaternion (⭐401) - Quaternion math module for VSL. Supports 3D rotations, spherical linear interpolation (slerp), and Julia fractal generation.
  • vtl.autograd (⭐166) - Automatic differentiation module for VTL. Enables gradient computation for machine learning and optimization.
  • vtl.datasets (⭐166) - Datasets module for VTL providing built-in datasets for ML benchmarking and tutorials.
  • vtl.nn (⭐166) - Neural Networks module for VTL. Build and train deep learning models with layers, activations, and optimizers.

Utility

  • vop (⭐0) - A message-passing object protocol providing dynamic property management and closure-based state encapsulation.

GitHub Actions / Vim

  • setup-v (⭐33) - GitHub Action to install and use V in your workflow. Available on the marketplace.
